title: The Borrowed Oars
story: Before Saturday's dinghy race, four rowers, Felix among them, took oars from the rack at Okafor Boatyard, and afterward every pair went back on the wrong hook. Felix wants each pair matched to its dinghy, shipshape. He has also noticed that his own little dinghy sits a few yards farther up the beach than he left it, which is not shipshape at all. Who rowed which dinghy, and with which oars?

cats.label: Oars
cats.either: used either the {a} or the {b} oars
cats.nor: used neither the {a} nor the {b} oars

texts: Otis rowed either the Minnow or the Skipjack.
Of the Skipjack's rower and the Teacup's rower, one is Amara and the other is Felix.
The Skipjack's rower used neither the varnished nor the ash oars.
The rower with the blue-tipped oars rowed either the Pebble or the Teacup.
The rower with the varnished oars is neither Felix nor Otis.
Of Felix and Amara, one used the varnished oars and the other used the spruce oars.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The Skipjack must go with the spruce oars: clue 3 rules out the varnished oars and the ash oars; clue 4 rules out the blue-tipped oars.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Otis must go with the Minnow: clue 1 rules out the Pebble and the Teacup; clue 2 rules out the Skipjack.
Walt must go with the Pebble: clue 2 rules out the Skipjack and the Teacup; the Minnow already goes with Otis.
The Minnow must go with the ash oars: clue 4 rules out the blue-tipped oars; the varnished oars is already ruled out for Otis; the spruce oars already goes with the Skipjack.
Otis must go with the ash oars: clue 5 rules out the varnished oars; the blue-tipped oars is already ruled out for the Minnow; the spruce oars is already ruled out for the Skipjack.
Clue 6 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Felix must go with the spruce oars: clue 5 rules out the varnished oars; clue 6 rules out the blue-tipped oars; the ash oars already goes with Otis.
Walt must go with the blue-tipped oars: clue 6 rules out the varnished oars; the spruce oars is already ruled out for the Skipjack; the ash oars already goes with Otis.
Amara must go with the varnished oars: clue 6 rules out the blue-tipped oars; the other choices are already taken.
The Skipjack goes with the spruce oars, so the Skipjack also goes with Felix.
Amara must go with the Teacup: clue 2 rules out the Minnow and the Pebble; the Skipjack already goes with Felix.
The varnished oars must go with the Teacup: clue 3 rules out the Skipjack; the Minnow is already ruled out for Otis; the Pebble is already ruled out for Walt.
The blue-tipped oars must go with the Pebble: clue 4 rules out the Minnow and the Skipjack; the Teacup already goes with the varnished oars.
